description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension following the demolition of the existing garage and rear conservatory
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: 2413.1/A101, 2413.1/A102, 2413.1/A103, 2413.2/A101, Location Plan Received 15 March 2024
2413.2/A102, 2413.2/A103 Received 01 May 2024.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - The extension hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose ancillary to the enjoyment of the house at the 'Site Address' described at the top of this decision letter and shall not be occupied as a separate dwelling other than as described in the submitted application, nor used for business purposes and shall not have a separate external side entrance.
